title: Simplify calculator selection flow
objective: Remove redundant selected-state summary UI and keep the calculator focused on the next choice.
changes: Removed the visible analysis-context summary above the calculator controls.
Kept the product/release chooser permanently hidden while only one analysis-ready release is active.
Preserved the visible interaction order as box type first, then team, player and spot price.
Set root HTML and index.html to Cache-Control: no-store so mobile browsers do not continue rendering an older selection UI after deployment.
Added a regression test for flow order, hidden release stage, removed context summary and document cache policy.
guarantees: Analysis-unit and technical-status updates still run even though the visible context summary is removed.
Product and format data-loading logic is unchanged.
Team, player, spot-price, EV and ROI calculation logic is unchanged.
This step changes presentation and HTML cache freshness only.
